id: vuln-spring-security-samples-4e3bec90
languages: [java]
message: "Spring Security: Incorrect authorization configuration using requestMatchers"
severity: WARNING
metadata:
  cwe: CWE-863
  cve: CVE-2023-34035
  author: "Semgrep Security Team"
  github: "https://github.com/returntocorp/semgrep-rules"
pattern: |
  public SecurityFilterChain securityFilterChain(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception {
    http
      .authorizeHttpRequests((authorize) -> authorize
        .requestMatchers(<requestMatchers>)<permitAll>
        .anyRequest().authenticated()
      )
      .jee((jee) -> jee.mappableRoles(<roles>));
    return http.build();
  }
